_texte.Cum primesc o comandă?: How do I receive an order?
_texte.My Darrin alocă automat comanda unui par: My Darrin automatically assigns the order to an available partner in the order's area. You receive an email with the service, date, time slot and locality, and the order appears in the dashboard, under Tasks.
_texte.Da, o poți declina din dashboard. Dacă e: Yes, you can decline it from the dashboard. If you are unavailable, you pause your account from the dashboard and receive no orders during that period.
_texte.Pot activa în mai multe orașe?: Can I work in several cities?
_texte.Da. În profilul tău declari raza de acop: Yes. In your profile you declare your coverage radius — you can select several counties or cities. My Darrin assigns orders based on your availability and coverage area.
_texte.Reține platforma un comision din manoper: Does the platform take a commission from the labour?
_texte.Nu. Comisionul din manoperă este 0%: pri: No. The commission on labour is 0%: you receive 100% of the labour price shown in the dashboard. The platform costs (platform commission, marketing and maintenance) are included in the price the customer pays and are not deducted from the labour.
_texte.Ce se întâmplă dacă clientul nu confirmă: What happens if the customer does not confirm?
_texte.Dacă clientul nu confirmă și nu deschide: If the customer neither confirms nor opens a complaint, the job is considered confirmed
_texte.O reclamație deschisă oprește confirmare: An open complaint stops the automatic confirmation.
